title: AquaPredict_UI
summary: A Streamlit-style web app for predicting water quality (pH, hardness, etc.) that imports SDV to build a metadata schema and run diagnostic/quality evaluation on data samples. SDV's single-table evaluation API (run_diagnostic, evaluate_quality, get_column_plot) is called directly in app.py to assess data quality.
evidence: app.py:12-13: from sdv.metadata import Metadata; from sdv.evaluation.single_table import run_diagnostic, evaluate_quality, get_column_plot
needs: No README available; unclear whether SDV synthesizers are trained here or only evaluation functions are invoked on existing data.
